newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine closes retail dealing rooms in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine closes retail dealing rooms in Thailand.

text.p: Peregrine Investment Holdings Ltd said it will close its retail dealing rooms in the Nonthaburi head office and the Sindhorn branch office in Bangkok "in the face of prolonged adverse market conditions".

"These steps will allow Peregrine Nithi's retail business to become more focused on more profitable accounts," Christopher Jackson, executive chairman of Peregrine Nithi Finance and Securities Ltd, said in a statement on Tuesday.
Peregrine Nithi is cutting costs, reflecting the difficult operating environment in Thailand with staff cutbacks in all business areas.
"We want to make it clear that this is no way reflects a diminished long-term commitment to the Peregrine Group's Thailand business," Jackson said.
"It is a decision made to reflect the tough economic and market conditions that face all securities companies in Thailand. We believe these are appropriate steps to be taking at this time."
